items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 15:1
items.html:
It explains the matter of Keter and ABYA, which are in the five Partzufim of Atzilut and in every degree, and it contains two matters: 1. The Parsa that is at the Chazeh of Atzilut is an inclusion from the general Parsa, and by it the world of Atzilut itself divides into ABYA. 2. Just as the world of Atzilut divides into ABYA by force of the general Parsa, so too every single degree divides into its own particular ABYA.

Now we shall explain the discernments of Keter and ABYA that are in the five Partzufim of Atzilut, wherein AA is Keter; and AVI Ilain [upper AVI], who clothe AA from the Peh to his Chazeh, are Atzilut; and Yeshsut, who clothe AA from the Chazeh to the Tabur, are Beria; and ZA and Malchut, who clothe AA from the Tabur downward, are Yetzira and Assiya.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 15:2
items.html:
The Parsa that is at the Chazeh of AA of Atzilut is an inclusion from the general Parsa, and by it the world of Atzilut itself divides into ABYA
And the reason for these names is that after the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG of AK divided at its Chazeh — so that from the Chazeh upward stands the world of Atzilut, and from the Chazeh downward stand the three worlds BYA, which emerged from the Kav of the light of Ein Sof, as above in the previous chapter — this too is included in the world of Atzilut itself, in the secret of the inclusion of the upper in the lower. And AA, who is the essence of the world of Atzilut — for just as every stature of ten Sefirot is discerned by the uppermost Sefira within it, so too every world is discerned according to the stature of the first Partzuf within it — he too divides at the Chazeh, so that from the Chazeh upward is discerned as Atzilut, and from the Chazeh downward as the BYA that is within Atzilut. And the Parsa that is at the place of the Chazeh of AA is the secret of an inclusion from the general Parsa that stands beneath the conclusion of the whole of Atzilut. Therefore AA himself, whose Rosh is revealed without any clothing, is discerned as Keter. And AVI, who clothe him down to the Chazeh, being clear even of the discernment of the inclusion of the Parsa, are discerned as Atzilut. But Yeshsut, who already stand below the Parsa at the Chazeh of AA, where the general Parsa is included, are reckoned as Beria. And ZA, who clothes only the NHY of AA, is reckoned as Yetzira. And Malchut, who clothes the Malchut of AA, is reckoned as Assiya. And with this you will understand how the three worlds BYA are bound up in Yeshsut and ZON of Atzilut, who clothe AA from the Chazeh downward.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, Histaklut Penimit 15:3
items.html:
Just as Atzilut divides into ABYA by force of the inclusion of the general Parsa, so too every single degree divides into its own particular ABYA
And by this the matter of the ten Sefirot of Keter and ABYA, which pertain in every single Partzuf among the Partzufim of ABYA, will likewise be explained. For just as it has been explained regarding the world of Atzilut as a whole, which is AA, that divides at the Chazeh, so that his Rosh is Keter, and from his Peh to his Chazeh is Atzilut, and from the Chazeh to the Tabur is Beria, and from the Tabur downward is Yetzira and Assiya — so too this is included in every single Partzuf among those of ABYA: in every single Partzuf among them, the Rosh is discerned as Keter, and from the Peh to the Chazeh as Atzilut, and from the Chazeh to the Tabur as Beria, and from the Tabur downward as Yetzira and Assiya.
